# BladeMaster and DexLab: Running Softbody Cutting Simulation

This chapter uses DexLab's CPU cutting method. It cuts the tofu-like soft blocks in half and performs three continuous cuts like a banana. Independent scoring is conducted, and playback is generated. DexLab refers to BladeMaster's TLMPM and persistent cutting history. The material parameters are set as synthetic values, and real ingredients have not been calibrated yet.

## 1. First, watch the project demo

- [ Cut tofu in half: surface video ](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/blob/main/docs/evidence/cutting/tofu/surface.mp4) · [ particle video ](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/blob/main/docs/evidence/cutting/tofu/particles.mp4) · [ experimental instructions ](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/blob/main/docs/site/zh/cutting.md). After cutting and removing the blade, a diagnostic impulse is applied to check the independent motion of the two materials.
- [ Three continuous cuts with a banana: surface video ](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/blob/main/docs/evidence/cutting/banana/surface.mp4) · [ particle video ](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/blob/main/docs/evidence/cutting/banana/particles.mp4) · [ experimental instructions ](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/blob/main/docs/site/zh/banana-cutting.md). After three cuts, an independent scorer is used to check whether four connected components are formed.
- [ BladeMaster project page ](https://jango6324.github.io/blademaster/) shows demonstrations of robot cutting, pushing, and cross-cutting based on the original paper; the implementation uses GPU, while DexLab is a separate CPU-based solution.

## 2. Prepare the environment

The following command is intended for Linux or WSL, using Python 3.12, Git, and a network accessible to PyPI. The official bounded executor requires running systemd, cgroup limits, and non-interactive sudo; WSL must have systemd enabled first. Simulation uses CPU; installing `cutting-render` dependencies is also required for generating surface playback. Ensure sufficient disk space, as the initial installation includes dependencies such as PyTorch. All commands should be executed in the root directory of the DexLab repository:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab.git
cd Dexlab
git checkout c7d958fe8bc1a2eb51429c95ae02f729f9176ef5
python3.12 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e '.[cutting,cutting-render]'
```

This submission fixes the source code corresponding to this chapter. If you need to use a later version, please also verify its official experimental instructions. After installation, run `python -c "import dexlab, numpy, scipy, numba, vtk; print('dependencies OK')"`, and if `dependencies OK` appears, it indicates that these dependencies can be imported. If `python3.12` cannot be found, install Python 3.12 and its venv support first. If rendering fails, check the installation output of `vtk`.

## 3. Run Tofu Cut in Half

DexLab provides bounded executors and shared research locks. First, specify the local output directory, the block device where this directory is located, and the shared lock path; `/dev/sda` is just an example. The actual devices should be identified through `findmnt -T "$CUT_ROOT"` and `lsblk`. All processes sharing the same research resources should use the same lock path; each `RUN`, resource plan, and receipt should use a new path. First, ensure that `systemctl is-system-running` can connect to systemd, and `sudo -n true` succeeds. The following uses a 4-core, 600-second setting as on the project experiment page:

```bash
CUT_ROOT="$HOME/dexlab-cutting"
mkdir -p "$CUT_ROOT"
findmnt -T "$CUT_ROOT"
lsblk
IO_DEVICE=/dev/sda                    # 改为实际块设备
LOCK="$CUT_ROOT/research.lock"
RUN="$CUT_ROOT/tofu-full-01"          # 每次换一个新路径
python scripts/bounded_run.py --profile adaptive \
  --resource-plan "$CUT_ROOT/tofu-plan.json" --cpu-cores 4 --io-device "$IO_DEVICE" \
  --data-dir "$CUT_ROOT" --timeout 600 --receipt "$CUT_ROOT/tofu-resources.json" -- \
  python scripts/research_guard.py run --lock "$LOCK" \
  --kind qualification --receipt "$CUT_ROOT/tofu-window.json" -- \
  .venv/bin/python -m dexlab.tofu_cut --output "$RUN"
python -m dexlab.cutting_score "$RUN"
```

The tofu baseline in the project record includes a 3-second simulation process: cutting, removing the tool, and applying a diagnostic impulse to one side. After the run, check `$RUN/manifest.json`, `states.npz`, `trace.npz`, and `score.json`. Based on the exit status of the independent scorer and `score.json`: a complete cut should form two connected components, and meet the displacement, contact, and numerical checks defined by the project. A successful exit by the runner only indicates that the recording process is over.

## 4. Run the banana continuous three cuts

Continue using the new output directory under the same environment and repository root directory. This task takes longer than tofu; the default record published by the project is about 215 seconds, and the actual time depends on the machine.

```bash
RUN="$CUT_ROOT/banana-full-01"
python scripts/bounded_run.py --profile adaptive \
  --resource-plan "$CUT_ROOT/banana-plan.json" --cpu-cores 4 --io-device "$IO_DEVICE" \
  --data-dir "$CUT_ROOT" --timeout 600 --receipt "$CUT_ROOT/banana-resources.json" -- \
  python scripts/research_guard.py run --lock "$LOCK" \
  --kind qualification --receipt "$CUT_ROOT/banana-window.json" -- \
  .venv/bin/python -m dexlab.tofu_cut --task banana --output "$RUN"
python -m dexlab.cutting_score "$RUN"
```

Check the grading results: The connected components after three cuts should reach 2, 3, and 4 respectively. The project also provides `--mode uncut` and `--mode partial` comparisons to verify whether the grading rejects the complete four-segment task when no cut is made or the third cut is shallow. A new output directory must be used for each comparison.

## 5. Generate and view the replay

Taking the just-completed banana record as an example, the simulation reads the existing physical state without running a new simulation. The official recommendation is to perform it in a separate restricted post-processing window. VTK rendering requires a available graphics environment or off-screen rendering support; after completion, search for videos and images in the output directory, and compare them with the official particle video in Section 1:

```bash
MEDIA="$CUT_ROOT/banana-media-01"
python scripts/bounded_run.py --profile adaptive \
  --resource-plan "$CUT_ROOT/render-plan.json" --cpu-cores 4 --io-device "$IO_DEVICE" \
  --data-dir "$CUT_ROOT" --timeout 600 --receipt "$CUT_ROOT/render-resources.json" -- \
  python scripts/research_guard.py run --lock "$LOCK" \
  --kind qualification --receipt "$CUT_ROOT/render-window.json" -- \
  .venv/bin/python -m dexlab.cutting_showcase "$RUN" --output "$MEDIA"
find "$MEDIA" -type f
```

Color indicates the cutting history; to determine whether the material is truly separated, one must consider the connection and cutting motion reconstructed by the scorer. In the time-step sensitivity results of the tofu experiment, the peak force values change significantly, and convergence in cutting force has not been established yet. It is suitable for learning numerical mechanisms, but should not be used directly as the cutting force of real ingredients.

## 6. How the cut is preserved

When the tool passes through the material, the solver records the cutting side for the particles; when particles and the grid transfer momentum, no incompatible coupling occurs on both sides of the cut surface. Thus, after removing the tool, the cut remains intact, while material contact allows the cut surface to come into contact and slide again. The bidirectional interaction between the tool and the material enables the material reaction force to influence the movement of the tool.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[刀具运动和材料粒子] --> B[记录切割侧别]
    B --> C[按相容关系传递动量]
    C --> D[材料接触和刀具反力]
    D --> E[保存状态并独立评分]
```

References: [ BladeMaster paper ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.27342), [ DexLab repository ](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab), [ Tofu experiment and full resource configuration ](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/blob/main/docs/site/zh/cutting.md), [ Banana experiment ](https://github.com/huangkiki/Dexlab/blob/main/docs/site/zh/banana-cutting.md).
